title: Collapse and entanglement candidates in clicks: an approval router and a common-past Z4 Bell test, CHSH 2 (r12 SCE b, c)
composition_note: composition.json = registry r13_device_spec (L=100, X0=6, XJ=22, nA=nB=44, k=20, k2=28) + pulse_train@1 light clock; every run is a control (mask/override). Exact regeneration of all 75 W2 initial states.
